title: Protein Crystallization
author: Opentrons
materials: This protocol performs protein crystallization on 96-samples.
Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Input your protocol parameters in the OT App interface before proceeding.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol file and unzip it if it is compressed.

steps.title: Upload custom labware
steps.instruction: In the OT App, navigate to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and select your custom labware files with a .json extension, if needed.

steps.title: Upload protocol script
steps.instruction: In the Protocol tab of the OT App, upload the protocol script file with a .py extension.

steps.title: Set up deck
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck according to the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Calibrate all labware, tip racks, and the pipette using the OT App calibration routine (see support articles for tips).

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press the Run button to start the protein crystallization protocol on the 96 samples.
